purpose: Every toolchain reference P27 may rely on, resolved to a digest or to a
repository source of truth. The implementer may not substitute a symbolic
tag for any of these, and may not download a second Go or Python toolchain.

golang:1.25.role: the upstream Go toolchain source, consumed only via tester-unified-go

tester-unified:local.repo_digest_absent_because: locally built, never pushed; its source of truth is the Dockerfile hash below

tester-unified-go:local.role: toolchain donor; ONLY /usr/local/go is copied out of it
tester-unified-go:local.repo_digest_absent_because: locally built, never pushed; its source of truth is the Dockerfile hash below

go_toolchain.gate_must_assert: the exact string above, not a prefix match on 1.25

identity.note: tester-unified-go declares USER 1003:1003 with a full passwd/group entry; the combined image must preserve a full identity, not only the numeric uid

run_placement.rule: verify the slice exists; never hardcode and never fall back -- a missing slice fails OPEN and silently unconfines the run

probe_invocation.note: the probes below used a tar pipe rather than a bind mount, because this devcontainer's /tmp is not visible at the same path to the Docker daemon; the gate itself binds the repository by its HOST path
